name: qbeta-option-e-forced-class
description: Option E under the formalize-first narrowing. Demanding that both admissible functionals agree on Delta is two equations in the two coordinates (chi_(3), chi_(2,1)) an admissible trace can see, so the class is forced (Lean: AdmissibleAgreementDeterminesClass, sorry-free). This computes the forced class and finds the current element Delta_S does NOT realise it -- its chi_(3) coordinate is 12.470 % off, exactly the known augmentation cell. Scope-(a): the independence requirement is POSITED, not derived; nothing wired.

assertions.name: trD_decomposes_in_the_admissible_character_basis
assertions.detail: unique solution found: 1 (overdetermined 6 eqns, 2 unknowns -- consistency is itself the admissibility check)

assertions.name: beta_is_nonzero_so_the_system_is_nondegenerate
assertions.detail: beta = q**2/(q**2 + 1)**2 != 0 -- this is the Lean hypothesis `hb : b2 != 0`; without it the class is NOT forced

assertions.name: trD_is_NORMALISED_alpha_plus_2beta_equals_one
assertions.detail: alpha + 2*beta = 1 exactly. chi_(3)(1)=1 and chi_(2,1)(1)=dim=2, so BOTH functionals lie on the normalised line -- the admissible family relevant here is one-parameter, not two

assertions.name: one_minus_alpha_over_beta_is_exactly_two
assertions.detail: (1-alpha)/beta = 2 for ALL q. So the forced second coordinate is exactly 2*T -- and 2 is dim V_(2,1), which is what makes the condition 'scalar modulo the radical' rather than a fit

assertions.name: chi_21_of_Delta_S_VANISHES_identically_over_Qq
assertions.detail: chi_(2,1)(Delta_S) = 0 exactly, while chi_(3)(Delta_S) = (1 - q**4)/(2*q**2) != 0. Delta_S is supported, modulo the radical, ENTIRELY in the trivial block

assertions.name: so_the_two_admissible_values_are_ONE_number_rescaled
assertions.detail: tr_M(z_D)(Delta_S) = alpha * aug(Delta_S) exactly. The +12.470 % and -43.157 % cells are NOT two independent estimates -- they are one value scaled by alpha = (q^4+1)/(q^2+1)^2 ~ 0.5054

assertions.name: Delta_S_is_NOT_scalar_modulo_the_radical
assertions.detail: b = 2a fails identically, so NO choice of admissible functional makes the Q-value independent of that choice. Scope-(b): the invariant is the vanishing of chi_(2,1) on Delta_S

assertions.name: Delta_S_does_NOT_realise_the_forced_class
assertions.detail: |chi_(3)(Delta_S)| = 0.210199349901 vs forced 0.186893667557 -- the current element does not satisfy functional-independence

assertions.name: the_chi3_gap_reproduces_the_known_augmentation_error
assertions.detail: chi_(3) gap = 12.4700225 % == the corpus's +12.470 % augmentation cell (calibration: the forced first coordinate IS the augmentation target, so this MUST match)

caveats: Functional-independence is POSITED, not a theorem of the framework. Nothing compels a physical quantity to be invariant under swapping the augmentation for the Markov trace.
Does NOT exhibit an element realising the forced class, and does not claim one exists among legitimate braid-word differences.
Delta_S only for the comparison; Delta_L is a separate element and qou-avt5's finding that the two differ is untouched.
q0AnchorReason: The character decomposition and the forced-class formula are exact over Q(q) and pin-free; q0 enters only to evaluate the target T = Q_codata/E0 and print the comparison.
